% 21.04.2023  CRL.M.A. 10513/2023 1. Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application stands disposed of.
3. The present petition has been filed under Section 438 Cr.P.C. by the petitioner seeking bail in case FIR No.933/2022 under Sections 376/313 IPC registered at Police Station Shahbad Dairy.
4. It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that petitioner and the victim came in contact in the year 2018.
It is further submitted that thereafter they had been constantly meeting and according to the FIR, the first incident of sexual relationship took place in October 2018.
It is further submitted that the relationship was consensual in nature and the petitioner has even taken the victim to his mother as he was intending to marry the victim.
It is further submitted that during the course of proceedings of bail application before the learned Trial Court, the petitioner has offered to marry the victim but the latter refused to marry.
It is further submitted that according to the last incident of consensual relationship happened in the April 2021 and the FIR was registered after 20 months in December, 2022.
It is further submitted that petitioner is ready to join the investigation and nothing is to be recovered from the petitioner.
5. Issue notice.
Learned APP for the State appears on advance notice and accepts notice.
He seeks time to file status report.
